steps.label: No Record
steps.sub: Finance can't see who approved what

code:
Entry Criteria:
  Status = "Submitted"
  AND Discount_Percent__c > 10

Step 1 (10-25%)  -> Owner's Manager
Step 2 (>25%)    -> Sales Director

Final Approval:  Status="Approved", unlock
Final Rejection: Status="Rejected", unlock, email
caption: Every quote under 10% skips the process entirely.
